verdicts.why: Stark sends the Mark XLII to form around Pepper during the mansion attack; in it she shields Tony from falling debris and flies Maya out. J.A.R.V.I.S. runs the armors, so the stage holds.
On Ego's planet Gamora attacks Mantis for answers, Drax demands she let go and says Mantis already told him everything; they then storm the palace together to save Quill.
Drax tells Groot 'Out of the way, dumber smaller Groot!', Groot angrily hits him, and at Yondu's funeral Groot is passed to Drax and sleeps on his shoulder.
Drax gives Quill advice on Gamora on the Milano, goes with him to Ego's planet, and when Nebula suggests abandoning Quill says they are family and leave no one behind.
Rocket reveals to Drax he stole the Anulax Batteries before the Sovereign attack; later Rocket orders Kraglin to take off, to Drax's objection as he demands to know where Quill is.
Kraglin flies the Ravager ship down to Ego's planet; Gamora and Nebula board it and he flies them off before the planet is destroyed. He acts directly for her; kind ally matches the tie.
Gamora has Rocket keep an eye on Nebula while she goes to Ego's planet; when she tries to go back for Quill, Rocket knocks her out with a taser.
Groot plants Rocket's bomb on Ego's core while Quill fights Ego, and in the Vol. 2 mid-credits scene (credits belong to their film) Quill tells adolescent Groot to clean his messy room.
Quill and Rocket argue on Berhert after the crash Rocket's theft caused; Rocket comes to Ego's planet with Yondu to rescue Quill and builds the battery bomb that kills Ego.
Kraglin stabilizes the ship's thrusters so Drax, carrying Mantis, can get aboard, and in a credits scene he accidentally fires the Yaka Arrow into Drax's chest.

value.title: X-Men (2000)
value.text: Scott leads Xavier's X-Men, bringing Logan and Rogue to the school. When Xavier falls into a coma, Scott thanks him for all he has done and takes the team to Liberty Island.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Leads Xavier's X-Men and watches over him in his coma.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Scott's teacher, who sends him and his X-Men out.

verdicts.why: They deal with each other (Xavier sends Scott and Storm, introduces Scott to Logan, orders Scott and Logan to settle their argument; Scott tells the comatose Xavier how much he appreciates him and leads the team to Liberty Island). But Xavier teaching Scott to control his power is not shown, and 'first students' is unsourced, so those lines are fixed.
During Professor X's physics class Logan barges in; when the class is dismissed Kitty goes back for her bag, greets the Professor and phases through the door. Mentor before the later ally stage fits.
At the Statue of Liberty Magneto binds Jean, Scott, Storm and Logan in metal restraints; Jean tells him Senator Kelly is dead and he ignores her.

From Sakaar Thor reaches Heimdall and sees Asgard through his eyes; Heimdall tells him to take the largest gateway, and on the Statesman answers 'What have I done?' with 'Asgard is not a place, it's a people.'
Thor: Ragnarok shows the full Sanctum scene: with directions from Strange, Thor and Loki find Odin in Norway. A Ragnarok stage is needed for the tie to show when Ragnarok is watched alone.

value.title: Thor: Ragnarok
value.text: Strange pulls Thor into the Sanctum, tells him where Odin is, and sends him and Loki to Norway to find their father.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer who sends Thor and Loki to Odin in Norway.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Strange sends him and Loki to find Odin in Norway.

verdicts.why: The owner wants each title on its own to show who deals with whom; the Sanctum scene is shown in Ragnarok, so it carries its own stage (the Doctor Strange stage stays, as credits scenes belong to their film).

value.title: Avengers: Infinity War
value.text: Heimdall dies at Thanos' hands after sending the Hulk to Earth.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Heimdall's friend and king. Heimdall hides Asgard's people until Thor returns.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's loyal friend. Hides Asgard's people, then dies at Thanos' hands.

verdicts.why: A stage's text says only what happens in its own title; hiding Asgard's people from Hela happens in Ragnarok, which now has its own stage. Trim the text to the Infinity War events (Heimdall sends the Hulk to Earth and Thanos kills him); the card lines are true and spoil nothing, so they stay.

The fox-wolverine node is dead in Deadpool & Wolverine (only his skeleton appears); the Logan who fights Lady Deathstrike in the Void is a variant from another universe, and the app itself calls her 'A Lady Deathstrike variant'. The film does not treat either as the X2 person.
Dopinder attends Wade's 2024 surprise party, tells Wade and Shatterstar about AirPods found in his cab, and later joins the dinner with Wade's friends, Logan and Laura.
Wade has moved back in with Blind Al; at the party she asks when he'll pay the rent and offers cocaine; after the Deadpool Corps fight he introduces her to Logan and Dogpool.
Colossus attends Wade's surprise party; Wade asks what he's watching and he answers The Great British Bake Off. Friend fits a party guest who remained his friend.
Negasonic attends the party and comments on Wade's obvious toupee, which he claims is a balayage.
Yukio attends the party with Negasonic; when Wade calls it a hair system, she says she loves it.

X-Force as a team does not appear or act in Deadpool & Wolverine; only Shatterstar, one former member, comes to the party. A stage says what happens between the two, not what one member of a group does nearby.
Buck attends the party; Wade stops him when he goes to speak and shoots him down for improvising during the speech.
After Vanessa's death Weasel tries to comfort Wade, who has spent three days drinking at Sister Margaret's, and helps him hold auditions for X-Force.
Dopinder wants to follow Wade into contract killing and asks to join X-Force; he drives Wade, Domino and Cable to the Essex House and runs over the headmaster, earning Wade's approval.
Wade, Colossus and Negasonic respond to the standoff with Russell at the orphanage; Colossus is still her mentor figure there.

No X-Force stage: the team does not appear in Deadpool & Wolverine, only Shatterstar at the party (n23 rejected). Whether Shatterstar should get his own node is a data-model choice for the owner, not a stage question.
Charles commands the Endeavour rescue; Peter speeds most of the crew out for Kurt to teleport back to the jet.
Xavier reveals he suppressed Jean's memories, and on the train 'Xavier and Scott convince McCoy, Lehnsherr, and their allies that Jean is not beyond help.'
Storm is on the Endeavour mission Charles commands, and after Raven's death she goes with Xavier's X-Men to New York to save Jean.
'Learning of Lehnsherr's plan, Kurt Wagner teleports the X-Men to New York to save her'; Xavier goes with them.
Raven, a field commander of the rescue, has Scott blast a hole so Kurt and Peter can get in, and Kurt teleports the crew back to the jet.

value.title: Dark Phoenix
value.text: Ororo flies on the space rescue Raven leads, then joins her and the X-Men at Jean's hometown to bring Jean home.
value.on_a_card_about_b: On Raven's team in space and at Jean's home.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Leads Ororo's team in space, then goes with her to Jean's home.

verdicts.why: Both are on the space rescue Raven co-commands and at Red Hook, but the Red Hook mission is commanded by Xavier, not Raven, so 'follows her' and 'leads Ororo's team to Jean's home' are wrong.
